camel_example: aliyun cas Decrypt --region cn-hangzhou --CiphertextBlob 'ZOyIygCyaOW6Gj0000MlNKiuyjfzw=' --CertIdentifier '1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265' --WarehouseId 1 --CustomIdentifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --Algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --MessageType Base64
description_en: Decrypts data that was encrypted by using a certificate in a certificate application repository
description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中证书解密
kebab_example: aliyun cas decrypt --cert-identifier 1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265 --algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --ciphertext-blob ZOyIygCyaOW6Gj0000MlNKiuyjfzw= --message-type Base64 --custom-identifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --warehouse-id 1 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Decrypt

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the certificate. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html to obtain this parameter.

- The identifier of an SSL certificate is typically in the format {Certificate ID}-cn-hangzhou.

- For a private certificate authority (PCA) certificate, this is the value of the Identifier field of the private certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书唯一识别码。该参数可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html获取。
- SSL证书识别码一般为{证书ID}-cn-hangzhou。
- PCA证书为对应私有证书的Identifier字段
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

- RAW: The response returns the plaintext in UTF-8 encoding.

- Base64 (default): The response returns the Base64-encoded plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型。取值：

- RAW：返回结果为UTF-8编码的原文。
- Base64（默认值）：返回结果为Base64加密之后的结果
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en: A custom identifier that serves as a unique key
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键
parameters.name: custom_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the repository.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
仓库ID。
> 此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html获取
parameters.name: warehouse_id
